resources.string: Photos, videos and documents are encrypted on this device. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
Keep the original where it is, or let TrueVault verify the encrypted copy first and then ask to remove it.
A scan checks the folders you allow, and shows you every duplicate before anything is deleted.
There is no account and no reset link. Without your password or recovery key, your vault cannot be recovered.
Your device supports advanced private-app options
You can configure Private Space later from TrueVault settings. Nothing about it is required to use the vault.
All file-security features are available. Private app isolation depends on your Android version and device manufacturer.
